This file documents the knowledge_pages resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =knowledge_pages=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: C30ED301-DCDF-5A32-8A0B-BB77876014D6
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
knowledge_pages list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =orgmode.v1.knowledge_pages.list=.

#+name: knowledge_pages-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle knowledge_pages-list.ores :exports none
knowledge_pages list --limit 1
#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 0A9562D8-20F6-5EC4-BD69-4D615D02C0C2

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
knowledge_pages get <id>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =orgmode.v1.knowledge_pages.get=.

#+name: knowledge_pages-get

knowledge_pages get __none__
#+end_src
